parent_checkpoint: current public-gate checkpoint to be named by the evaluator implementation manifest
parent_objective: design a no-update full-corpus source-history objective evaluator over M1336 active rows
blocked_by: M1337 admits evaluator design but no evaluator specification exists for the materialized active corpus
supersedes: direct materialized source-history actor update without exact no-update evaluator

public_gates: M1338 must not mutate checkpoint weights
M1338 must not use private holdout
M1338 must preserve actor input contract
M1338 must design full-corpus active-row evaluator semantics
M1338 must keep quarantined rows out of the active objective
forbidden_shortcuts: do not include halfshaft quarantine in active objective
do not hide global friction gap

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs an exact no-update evaluator for the M1336 active materialized source-history objective corpus
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if evaluator design requires hidden parameters in actor input
stop if evaluator design includes quarantine rows as active objective rows
stop if evaluator design cannot check checkpoint immutability
stop if design routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if design passes, implement one no-update exact evaluator
if evaluator needs missing columns, repair M1336 export
if quarantine rows are needed, pivot to halfshaft/global-friction source repair
if checkpoint projection is ambiguous, add a compatibility audit before implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1337 routes active export to no-update evaluator design

admission_evidence: PPO and actor update remain blocked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: evaluator inputs and row joins are specified
correct-history and wrong-history residuals are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1338 designs an offline exact evaluator and does not test deployed closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design correct-history versus wrong-history action likelihood and action-distance residuals using materialized command-response histories
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the no-update evaluator finds weak or contradictory history signal, record it as objective/evidence weakness before any actor update.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A no-update full-corpus evaluator can be designed to measure source-history correct-history versus wrong-history residuals on M1336 active rows before any actor update.
success_criteria: design specifies required input artifacts and joins
design specifies correct-history versus wrong-history log-likelihood residuals
design specifies exact full-corpus summary metrics
design keeps quarantined rows out of active objective rows
design admits one no-update implementation milestone
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: residual definitions are missing or depend on hidden actor inputs
quarantined rows enter the active objective
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1338 passes as a design milestone if it specifies an exact no-update active-corpus evaluator with correct-history/wrong-history residuals, action-distance diagnostics, immutability checks, quarantine exclusion, and one safe implementation route.
